programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: The legendary Marsupilamis swap the wild Palombian jungle for an even wilder place: the city. There, twins Jade and Mica find their world turned upside down when their explorer parents entrust them with three mysterious Marsupilami eggs. Once they hatch, the siblings must get creative to keep their new friends hidden after all, no one knows these energetic creatures exist, and predators could be lurking around every corner.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. programme.title: Dapur Panik
programme.desc: After success in Spain, Turkey, Argentina and four other countries, My Mom Cooks Better than Yours successfully raised family secret recipes into inspirational recipes. But all of that is certainly not easy, cooking with lots of equipment, spices and processed ingredients and a short time, can contain panic, especially for beginners.

programme.title: Dapur Panik
programme.desc: Setelah sukses di Spanyol, Turki, Argentina dan empat negara lainnya, My Mom Cooks Better Than Yours berhasil mengangkat resep-resep rahasia keluarga menjadi resep inspirasi. Tapi semua itu pastinya tidaklah mudah, memasak dengan banyak perlalatan, bahan bumbu dan bahan olahan serta waktu yang singkat, bisa memuat panik, terutama bagi pemula.

programme.desc: Salah satu program unggulan terbaru dari iNews yang siap memberikan ulasan lengkap soal berbagai informasi seputar kuliner pilihan yang tersebar di Indonesia, mengeksplor dan menelusuri kuliner-kuliner lezat, mulai dari street food hingga berbagai tempat viral yang belum banyak diketahui banyak orang.

programme.title: Top 5
programme.desc: Diana was used to a world where black women who were successful were always compared and put against each other. Her high school career she was always surrounded by envious friends who were not seeing the same results as her and could not handle her success. Chloe, Tierra, Alexus, Imani, and Shanice were breaking these norms, while Chloe was the social media mogul, Tierra was student body president maintaining her 4.0 gpa, Alexus was at the forefront of fighting for human rights, Imani's outgoing personality made her an easy pick for Miss Jemison College, and Shanice's entrepreneurial spirit took her business to unbelievable heights

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World is a news magazine program that delivers in-depth reports on international affairs, global trends, and human-interest stories. Covering topics such as politics, business, technology, culture, and social issues, the program highlights how events around the world influence people's lives while presenting unique Taiwanese perspectives on international developments.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. Melalui peliputan langsung, wawancara, dan analisis yang komprehensif, program ini memberikan perspektif yang lebih luas terhadap berbagai isu global sekaligus menyoroti dampaknya terhadap kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player follows Pun, who returns to Thailand after her fiancé disappears with her savings. Determined to find him, she approaches Ploy, a successful actress and the fugitive's sister, hoping to uncover his whereabouts. As their relationship grows more complicated, secrets, deception, and unexpected romance emerge, forcing both women to confront the truth while navigating danger, betrayal, and their evolving feelings for one another.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player mengisahkan Pun yang kembali ke Thailand setelah tunangannya melarikan diri membawa seluruh tabungannya. Dalam upaya mencari pelaku, ia mendekati Ploy, seorang aktris ternama yang juga merupakan adik sang buronan. Pencarian tersebut perlahan membuka berbagai rahasia, kebohongan, dan konspirasi yang tidak pernah mereka duga. Di tengah konflik yang semakin rumit, hubungan keduanya berkembang menjadi kisah yang menguji kepercayaan, keberanian, dan arti cinta yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: Flavor Of Life
programme.desc: At 40, Han Xiao leaves her dream job to reopen her parents' canteen. Her father's return with dementia forces the family to confront old wounds and learn how to rebuild their lives together.

programme.title: Flavor Of Life
programme.desc: Di usia 40 tahun, Han Xiao meninggalkan pekerjaan impiannya dan membuka kembali kedai milik orang tuanya. Kepulangan sang ayah yang mengidap demensia memaksa keluarga menghadapi luka lama dan belajar memulai kembali.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey takes viewers on a flavorful exploration of diverse culinary traditions across different regions. Each episode highlights local ingredients, time-honored recipes, and the stories of chefs, home cooks, and artisans who preserve their communities' food heritage. Combining travel, history, and gastronomy, the series celebrates how food reflects culture, identity, and everyday life.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey mengajak pemirsa menyusuri berbagai daerah untuk mengenal kekayaan kuliner lokal. Setiap episode menampilkan bahan-bahan khas, resep tradisional, serta kisah para koki, juru masak rumahan, dan pelaku kuliner yang menjaga warisan gastronomi daerahnya. Dipadukan dengan unsur perjalanan dan budaya, program ini memperlihatkan bagaimana makanan menjadi bagian penting dari identitas dan kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: Hot Door Night

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online is a Taiwanese current affairs talk show produced by Sanlih News. Hosted by Hsu Kuei-ya, the program covers the day's major headlines, including domestic politics, international affairs, economic developments, and social issues. Through discussions with journalists, academics, analysts, and invited guests, the show provides multiple perspectives and detailed analysis to help viewers better understand the impact of current events in Taiwan and around the world.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Pro On Their Speciality
programme.desc: Pro On Their Speciality is a long-running lifestyle magazine program produced by Sanlih E-Television. Traveling across Taiwan, the show introduces viewers to outstanding professionals, traditional craftsmen, innovative entrepreneurs, farmers, and culinary experts who excel in their respective fields. Along the way, it showcases local culture, regional specialties, hidden destinations, and inspiring success stories, offering an engaging look at Taiwan's diverse communities and industries.

programme.title: Pro On Their Speciality
programme.desc: Pro On Their Speciality merupakan program magazine gaya hidup yang menampilkan kisah inspiratif dari berbagai penjuru Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi tokoh-tokoh dengan keahlian khusus, seperti pengrajin, petani, pelaku UMKM, hingga pakar kuliner yang sukses mengembangkan bidangnya. Selain mengangkat perjalanan dan dedikasi mereka, acara ini juga memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya, tradisi, makanan khas, serta destinasi menarik yang mencerminkan keberagaman Taiwan. Dengan perpaduan informasi, perjalanan, dan kisah inspiratif, program ini memberikan wawasan sekaligus hiburan bagi pemirsa.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Traditional powerhouses such as Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore battle alongside rising contenders in an exciting home-and-away format, with every match playing a crucial role in the race to become ASEAN champions. The tournament is staged across multiple ASEAN countries rather than at a single host nation.

programme.title: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026

programme.title: 64' ACTU

programme.title: 64' ACTU
programme.desc: 64' Actu menyajikan liputan mendalam berita nasional dan internasional dengan laporan, analisis, dan komentar ahli.

programme.title: 64' DÉBAT
programme.desc: 64' Débat brings journalists, experts, and commentators together to discuss key political, social, and economic topics shaping today’s world.

programme.title: 64' DÉBAT
programme.desc: 64' Débat mempertemukan jurnalis dan pakar untuk membahas isu politik, sosial, dan ekonomi yang sedang berkembang.

programme.title: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026
programme.desc: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026 features Patrick Simonin in conversations with artists, writers, actors, and other notable personalities. Through engaging interviews, guests discuss their careers, projects, experiences, and the topics shaping current cultural and public life.

programme.title: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026
programme.desc: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026 menghadirkan Patrick Simonin dalam wawancara bersama artis, penulis, aktor, dan berbagai tokoh terkenal. Para tamu berbagi cerita tentang karier, karya, pengalaman, serta berbagai topik yang menjadi perhatian dalam kehidupan budaya dan masyarakat saat ini.

programme.title: AFRICAN EMPIRES
programme.desc: This docudrama series revisits the history of Africa's pre-colonial empires, highlighting visionary kings, conquerors, and warrior queens who shaped the continent across regions including Mali, Sudan, South Africa, and Burkina Faso.

programme.title: AFRICAN EMPIRES
programme.desc: Serial dokudrama ini mengulas sejarah kerajaan dan kekaisaran Afrika pra-kolonial dengan menampilkan kisah raja, penakluk, dan ratu pejuang yang membentuk peradaban di Mali, Sudan, Afrika Selatan, Burkina Faso, dan wilayah lainnya.

programme.title: L'ÉPICERIE
programme.desc: The ever-increasing numbers of claims about being green, more or less scientifically-based, printed on packaging do little to help customers make better choices. Also on the programme: chocolate-flavoured protein drinks; an online farmers' market; Mexican and Colombian-style tamales.

programme.title: SECRETS DES PROFONDEURS
programme.desc: With Alex-William Miousse, Mario and Samuel are hoping to identify a wreck discovered in 2018. Their investigation has led them to a plausible theory: it could well be the ''Wearmouth'', a British iron-built steamship, first launched in 1880.

programme.title: UN SI GRAND SOLEIL
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: CHÂTEAU !
programme.desc: CHÂTEAU ! takes viewers inside remarkable French castles, revealing their architectural secrets, legendary residents, and historical transformations. Blending expert commentary with stunning visuals, the series uncovers the cultural heritage preserved within these iconic landmarks.

programme.title: CHÂTEAU !
programme.desc: CHÂTEAU ! mengajak penonton memasuki kastel-kastel menakjubkan di Prancis, mengungkap rahasia arsitektur, tokoh legendaris, serta perubahan sejarahnya. Dipadukan dengan komentar pakar dan visual yang memukau, serial ini menyoroti warisan budaya yang tersimpan di bangunan ikonik tersebut.

programme.title: LES GESTES VERRIERS
programme.desc: This documentary traces the evolution of glassmaking from ancient Mesopotamia and Egypt to modern workshops, highlighting traditional techniques, artistic innovation, and a craft recognized as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

programme.title: LES GESTES VERRIERS
programme.desc: Menelusuri perjalanan seni pembuatan kaca sejak Mesopotamia dan Mesir kuno hingga bengkel modern, dokumenter ini menampilkan warisan budaya takbenda UNESCO melalui keterampilan para seniman dan perajin kaca.

programme.title: 6H INFO
programme.desc: 6H Info delivers up-to-date national and international news, providing viewers with key headlines, reports, and context to start the day informed.

programme.title: 6H INFO
programme.desc: 6H Info menyajikan berita nasional dan internasional terkini sebagai informasi awal di pagi hari.

programme.title: TÉLÉMATIN

programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE
programme.desc: Les Belges du Bout du Monde is a long-running Belgian travel and cultural magazine hosted by Adrien Joveneau. The program takes viewers on journeys across the globe to discover the lives of Belgian citizens who have chosen to settle abroad. Through personal interviews, local discoveries, and encounters with different communities, the show explores themes of migration, cultural exchange, adventure, and human connection. Each episode offers a unique portrait of a destination through the eyes of Belgians who have built new lives far from Belgium, while highlighting the diversity of cultures and experiences found around the world.

programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE

Setiap episode menghadirkan wawancara dengan para ekspatriat, eksplorasi budaya lokal, serta cerita tentang perjalanan, adaptasi, dan hubungan antarmanusia. programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE
programme.desc: Les Belges du Bout du Monde is a long-running Belgian travel and cultural magazine hosted by Adrien Joveneau. The program takes viewers on journeys across the globe to discover the lives of Belgian citizens who have chosen to settle abroad. Through personal interviews, local discoveries, and encounters with different communities, the show explores themes of migration, cultural exchange, adventure, and human connection. Each episode offers a unique portrait of a destination through the eyes of Belgians who have built new lives far from Belgium, while highlighting the diversity of cultures and experiences found around the world.

programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE
programme.desc: Les Belges du Bout du Monde merupakan program majalah perjalanan dan budaya Belgia yang dipandu oleh Adrien Joveneau. Acara ini mengajak penonton menjelajahi berbagai negara melalui kisah warga Belgia yang memilih membangun kehidupan jauh dari tanah kelahiran mereka. Setiap episode menghadirkan wawancara dengan para ekspatriat, eksplorasi budaya lokal, serta cerita tentang perjalanan, adaptasi, dan hubungan antarmanusia. Dengan pendekatan yang hangat dan penuh rasa ingin tahu, program ini memperlihatkan keberagaman dunia sekaligus pengalaman unik orang Belgia yang hidup di berbagai penjuru bumi.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 5
programme.desc: Fresh off the Sea returns for its 3rd season. A real 'Fishing to Dining' life with harder work and a more colorful seasonal table. Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, and Roh Yoon Seo travel to seas, fields, and rivers to harvest fresh seasonal ingredients. They turn their hard work into hearty meals.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 5
programme.desc: Fresh off the Sea kembali dengan musim ketiganya, menghadirkan kehidupan nyata bertema "dari laut ke meja makan" dengan tantangan yang lebih berat dan sajian musiman yang semakin beragam. Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, dan Roh Yoon Seo menjelajahi laut, ladang, serta sungai untuk memanen bahan-bahan segar sesuai musim, lalu mengolah hasil kerja keras mereka menjadi hidangan lezat.

programme.title: GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria, Ep 1
programme.desc: GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria is a derivative program of the series that focuses on the casual interactions between characters in a cafe or cafeteria environment.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake, Ep 4
programme.desc: The cast members take on a new set of space-themed missions designed to challenge their creativity, cooperation, and adaptability. As they work together to overcome unexpected obstacles, friendly competition and lighthearted moments create plenty of laughs. Their performances determine who gains advantages while bringing viewers another entertaining chapter of the imaginative variety series.

programme.title: Space Rice Cake, Ep 4
programme.desc: Para peserta kembali menjalani serangkaian misi bertema luar angkasa yang menguji kreativitas, kekompakan, dan kemampuan mereka beradaptasi dengan berbagai situasi tak terduga. programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. programme.title: English Vinglish
programme.desc: Shashi endures taunts and is ridiculed by her well-educated husband and daughter everyday because of her inability to speak and understand English. But, a visit to her sister's house in Manhattan changes everything.

programme.title: English Vinglish
programme.desc: Setiap hari, Shashi diejek dan diolok-olok oleh suami dan putrinya karena tak mampu memahami dan berbicara dalam bahasa Inggris. Namun, segalanya berubah saat ia berkunjung ke rumah saudari perempuannya di Manhattan.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda and Indy are sisters who love each other dearly. Their mother, Rianty, died while giving birth to Indy. Since then, Manda and Indy have lived as a family of three with their father, Indra. Manda has taken on the role of a mother to Indy. One day, their father began to fall ill and was admitted to the hospital. It turned out that Indra had leukemia.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: MenemukanMu
programme.desc: Seorang narablog fesyen bernama Raya (Yoriko Angeline) melakukan perjalanan ke Turki setelah menolak khitbah dari kekasihnya. Ia berniat untuk mengkaji lebih dalam puisi-puisi dari idolanya, yakni Jalaluddin Rumi.
